description: Strict wrapper structural contract with complete native component results. See ../docs/validation/supplied-transcript-runtime.md.
$comment: Resolve all references offline using a local registry keyed by sibling schema filenames. Validate finite, duplicate-free UTF-8 JSON before this schema. Runtime and independent adapters remain authoritative for hashes and canonical serialization (including 33554432-byte output limit); equality of original requests, annotations, sequences and identities; native model/source/parameter/backend verification; scalar equations, unit meaning, score/log relations and biological validity; CDS eligibility, relational interval bounds/order/length and signed offsets; strand/coordinate transforms, genomic run order, projection fit/crossing and empty-run correspondence; roster/site-index correspondences, ordering, coverage sums/status counts and requested-versus-returned completeness; declared-budget binding, deadlines and execution success. Schema can bound individual counts but cannot prove their arithmetic consistency. JSON Schema integer accepts integral floats and number accepts integers; runtime/adapters must enforce genuine integer coordinates/counts and prescribed float settings. Backend identity and native model source/parameter dictionaries retain their admitted typed extension contracts; schema acceptance does not verify their provenance. Predictions are not measurements or an integrated Operon/abundance model.

backend.$comment: Complete caller-supplied RnaStructure.identity, including synthetic fixture identities. Native backend identity keys are extensible; typed JSON is intentional. Schema cannot verify an engine installation or the identity content.
